P0-1_mandatory.answer: An application number follows the format **YEAR/SERVICE_CODE/DISTRICT_CODE/SERIAL_NUMBER** (e.g. 2026/0154/28/001167). The service code is 0154 for ISD, or 0153 for NISD; the district code is 2 digits (28 for Thoothukudi); the serial number is 6 digits.
